Stir-fry the broccoli in the rest of the oil with a splash of water until bright green.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, syrup and vinegar, then the tofu. Toss and serve over rice.

name: Mushroom and Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and stir in the lime juice.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the beans, corn, taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Build bowls with rice, the bean mix and salsa.

name: Lemon Garlic Butter Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the asparagus with the oil on a sheet pan and push to the sides.
Set the salmon in the middle.
Mix the butter, garlic and lemon juice and spoon over the salmon.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Lettuce Wraps
steps: Shape the beef into 4 patties and cook in a skillet, 4 minutes a side. Top with cheese to melt.
Wrap each burger in big lettuce leaves with tomato, pickles, mustard and mayo.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowls over Cauliflower Rice
steps: Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil and seasoning.
Cook in a hot skillet in two batches until charred and the chicken is done.
Heat the cauliflower rice. Serve the fajita mix over it with sour cream and avocado.

name: Creamy Garlic Chicken with Spinach

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin

steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, 5 minutes a side; set aside.
Add the garlic, then the cream, parmesan and seasoning. Simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and return the chicken to the sauce.

name: Sausage, Peppers and Cauliflower Sheet Pan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss everything on a sheet pan.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once, until the cauliflower browns.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
steps: Brown the pork in a big skillet; drain.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the coleslaw mix and soy sauce.
Cook until the cabbage is just tender, 5 minutes. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

name: Taco-Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Brown the beef, drain, and stir in the taco seasoning and salsa.
Fill the pepper halves, set in a baking dish, and bake 25 minutes.
Top with cheese, bake 5 more minutes, and serve with sour cream.

name: Garlic Butter Pork Chops with Green Beans
steps: Season the chops with thyme and sear in the oil, 4 to 5 minutes a side; set aside.
Add the green beans and a splash of water, cover 4 minutes.
Add the butter and garlic, toss, and return the chops to warm through.

name: Steak and Broccoli Stir-Fry

ingredients.item: flank or sirloin steak, sliced thin

steps: Sear the steak in half the oil over high heat in batches; set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the rest of the oil with a splash of water until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic, ginger, soy and oyster sauce, then the steak. Toss and serve.

name: Microwave Mug Omelet
steps: Spray a big mug with cooking spray.
Whisk in the eggs and milk, then stir in the cheese and ham or pepper.
Microwave 45 seconds, stir, then 30 to 45 seconds more until set. Eat with the bread.

name: Microwave Loaded Potato
steps: Poke the potato all over with a fork. Microwave 5 minutes, turn it, and microwave 3 to 5 minutes more until soft.
Microwave the broccoli in a covered bowl with a splash of water, 2 minutes.
Split the potato, add butter, broccoli and cheese; microwave 30 seconds and top with sour cream.

name: Microwave Burrito Bowl
steps: Microwave the rice pouch as the package says.
In a bowl, microwave the beans and corn 1 minute.
Top the rice with beans, corn, salsa and cheese; microwave 30 seconds to melt.

name: Mac and Cheese in a Mug
steps: Put the macaroni and water in a big mug.
Microwave 2 minutes, stir, and repeat 2 or 3 times until the pasta is tender (add a splash of water if it dries out).
Stir in the milk and cheese and microwave 30 seconds. Stir until creamy.

name: Microwave Chicken and Veggie Rice Bowl
steps: Microwave the vegetables in a covered bowl with a splash of water, 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and teriyaki sauce and microwave 1 minute.
Microwave the rice pouch and top with the chicken and vegetables.

name: Microwave Bean and Cheese Nachos
steps: Spread the chips on a microwave-safe plate.
Dot with spoonfuls of beans and sprinkle with cheese.
Microwave 60 to 90 seconds until melted. Top with salsa and sour cream.

name: Microwave Sweet Potato with Black Beans
steps: Poke the sweet potato and microwave 5 minutes, turn, and 3 to 4 minutes more until soft.
Microwave the beans with the cumin, 1 minute.
Split the potato and fill with beans, salsa and yogurt.

name: Upgraded Instant Ramen with Egg and Veggies
steps: Put the noodles, half the seasoning packet, the vegetables and the water in a big microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave 3 minutes. Crack in the egg, poke the yolk, and microwave 60 to 90 seconds more until the egg is set.
Top with green onion.

name: Garlic Spinach Pasta for One
steps: Cook the spaghetti; save a splash of the water.
Warm the oil and garlic until golden, add the pepper flakes and spinach until wilted.
Toss in the pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.

name: Personal Pita Pizza
steps: Heat the oven or toaster oven to 425°F.
Top the pita with sauce, cheese and pepperoni.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until bubbly.

name: Ham and Egg Fried Rice for One
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet, scramble the egg and push it aside.
Add the ham and vegetables for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot.

name: Single Skillet Chicken Thigh and Potatoes
steps: Cook the potato in the oil, covered, 8 minutes.
Push aside, season the chicken and cook it 5 to 6 minutes a side until done, stirring the potatoes now and then.

name: Black Bean Quesadilla for One
steps: Spread the beans and cheese over one tortilla and top with the other.
Toast in a skillet 2 to 3 minutes a side until melted.
Cut in wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Small-Batch Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey and onion in a small pot.
Add everything else and simmer 20 minutes.
Eat one bowl tonight and save the other for lunch.

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders with Honey Mustard
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the panko, parmesan and oil.
Dip the tenders in egg, then the crumbs, and set on a rack or sheet pan.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden. Stir the honey and mustard together for dipping.

name: Mini Meatloaf Muffins with Mashed Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Mix the beef, breadcrumbs, egg and half the ketchup.
Press into 12 muffin cups, top with the rest of the ketchup, and bake 20 to 25 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, drain, and mash with the milk and butter.

name: Cheesy Chicken and Rice Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Stir the rice, broth, milk, chicken and garlic powder together in a greased 9x13 dish.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 40 minutes.
Stir in the broccoli, top with cheese, and bake uncovered 15 minutes.

name: Classic Sloppy Joes
steps: Brown the beef with the onion; drain.
Stir in the ketchup, brown sugar, mustard and Worcestershire and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon onto buns.

name: Homemade Pizza Night
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F and oil a sheet pan.
Stretch the dough to fill the pan; let the kids add sauce, cheese and toppings.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken and Corn Quesadillas
steps: Fill half of each tortilla with chicken, corn and cheese and fold.
Toast in a buttered skillet until golden and melty, 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Freezer Beef and Bean Burritos
steps: Brown the beef, drain, and stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water, then the beans.
Fill each tortilla with rice, the beef mix and cheese, and roll tightly.
Wrap each in foil and freeze. Reheat from frozen: unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave 2 to 3 minutes.

name: Make-Ahead Baked Ziti
steps: Cook the pasta 2 minutes short of done and drain. Brown the meat and drain.
Mix the pasta, meat, sauce, ricotta and half the mozzarella.
Split between two 8x8 pans and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake one at 375°F for 25 minutes; wrap the other and freeze (bake from thawed, about 35 minutes).

name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Layer a third of the tortillas, chicken, beans, sauce and cheese in a greased dish; repeat twice.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbly. (Or cover and freeze before baking.) Serve with sour cream.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, parmesan, eggs and seasoning; roll into 1 1/2-inch balls.
Bake on a sheet pan 18 to 20 minutes.
Simmer half the meatballs in the sauce and serve over spaghetti; freeze the rest flat in a bag for another night.

name: Slow Cooker White Chicken Chili
steps: Put everything but the cream cheese in the slow cooker. (Or bag it raw and freeze: it's a dump-and-go dinner.)
Cook on low 6 hours or high 4 hours.
Shred the chicken, stir in the cream cheese until melted.

name: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain, and mash with the milk and butter.
Brown the beef and onion; drain. Stir in the tomato paste, broth, Worcestershire and vegetables and simmer 5 minutes.
Spread the filling in a baking dish and top with the potatoes.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes (or cover and freeze before baking).

name: Herb-Roasted Chicken and Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the sweet potatoes and onion with 2 Tbsp oil and half the herbs; roast 15 minutes.
Add the chicken rubbed with the rest of the oil, herbs and lemon zest. Roast 20 to 25 minutes. Squeeze the lemon over everything.

name: Turkey and Veggie Stir-Fry with Low-Sodium Soy
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey, then add the vegetables and cook until hot.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, low-sodium soy, vinegar and honey. Serve over rice.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Fish with Rice and Green Beans
steps: Cook the rice.
Heat the oven to 400°F. Set the fish and green beans on a sheet pan, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with dill.
Lay lemon slices over the fish and bake 12 to 15 minutes.

name: No-Salt-Added Taco Bowls
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the beef and stir in the spices (a homemade taco seasoning without the salt) and a splash of water.
Warm the beans. Build bowls with rice, beef, beans, tomato and avocado, and squeeze lime over the top.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos

ingredients.item: medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cut in 1/2-inch cubes

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potatoes with the oil, chili powder, cumin and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Warm the black beans in a small pot. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill the tortillas with sweet potatoes and beans; top with avocado and salsa, and squeeze lime over.

name: Red Lentil Dal with Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils fall apart.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach until the spinach wilts. Season with the salt and serve over rice.

name: Veggie Fried Rice with Tofu
steps: Pat the tofu dry. Brown it in 1 Tbsp oil in a big skillet over medium-high heat, 8 minutes, turning. Move to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, the garlic and the white parts of the green onions for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and peas and carrots; stir-fry 5 minutes until hot and a little crisp.
Stir in the tofu, tamari and sesame oil. Top with the green onion tops.
prepAhead: Cook the rice a day ahead: cold rice fries best.

name: Chickpea Shawarma Bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the chickpeas and onion with the oil, spices and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes, shaking the pan once, until the chickpeas are crisp.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa.
Fill bowls with quinoa, chickpeas and onion, cucumber and tomatoes. Thin the hummus with lemon juice and water and drizzle over.

name: Three-Bean Vegetable Chili
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and carrots in the oil 8 minutes. Stir in the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans, tomatoes, corn and broth. Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Season with the salt. Serve with tortilla chips or over rice.

name: Peanut Sweet Potato Stew

ingredients.item: medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil 5 minutes; stir in the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potatoes, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth. Simmer 20 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Whisk the peanut butter with a ladle of the hot broth, then stir it in with the kale. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Stuffed Peppers with Rice and Black Beans

ingredients.item: large bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Stand the peppers in a baking dish.
Stir together the rice, beans, corn, tomatoes, cumin, chili powder and salt. Pack into the peppers.
Add 1/4 cup water to the dish, cover with foil and bake 35 minutes, until the peppers are tender.
Top with avocado.
prepAhead: Stuff the peppers the night before and keep them covered in the fridge.

name: Coconut Chickpea Spinach Curry with Potatoes
steps: Soften the onion in the oil 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk and broth. Simmer 20 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted; season with the salt.

name: Mexican Rice and Bean Skillet
steps: Soften the onion in the oil 4 minutes. Add the rice and stir 2 minutes until it smells toasty.
Stir in the beans, tomatoes, broth, cumin and chili powder. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Stir in the corn, cover 5 minutes off the heat. Top with cilantro.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes until tender; drain and mash with the oat milk, 1 Tbsp oil and half the salt.
Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the rest of the oil 8 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the lentils, broth, tomato paste and thyme. Simmer 25 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the sauce thick. Stir in the peas and the rest of the salt.
Heat the oven to 400°F. Spread the lentils in a baking dish, top with the potatoes and bake 20 minutes, until golden on top.

name: Cheesy Black Bean Enchilada Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Mash half the beans and stir in the rest with the corn and cumin.
Spread a little sauce in a 9x13 dish. Layer tortillas, beans, sauce and cheese; repeat twice, ending with sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes; uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Serve with sour cream.

name: Veggie Frittata with Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Cook the potatoes in the oil in an oven-safe skillet 10 minutes, until tender. Add the pepper and spinach for 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and half the cheese; pour over the vegetables. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Cook on the stove 3 minutes, until the edges set, then bake 12 to 15 minutes until the center is set.

name: Baked Potato Bar with Broccoli and Cheese
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the potatoes with the oil and salt, prick them and bake 50 to 60 minutes, until soft.
Steam the broccoli 5 minutes. Warm the beans.
Split the potatoes and let everyone top their own with broccoli, beans, cheese, sour cream and green onions.

name: Caprese Quinoa Bowls with White Beans
steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool a few minutes.
Toss with the beans, tomatoes, mozzarella and basil.
Drizzle with the oil and balsamic, season with the salt and toss again.
